Every package includes

  • Your own web address, registered in your name, in your own account.
  • Business email at your address, set up so your messages are less likely to land in spam.
  • Your website on Cloudflare, with a secure connection (the padlock in the browser), fast loading, and basic protection against attacks.
  • Your Google Maps listing (Google Business Profile) set up and connected to your site.
  • Search basics: page titles, descriptions, and a site map sent to Google. This is a one-time setup, not ongoing search work.
  • Links to your existing social media profiles.
  • Visitor statistics, so you can see how many people visit.
  • A review link and QR code that make it easy for customers to leave you a Google review.
  • A working contact form, tested from start to finish.
  • Accessibility built in: readable colors, image descriptions, and a site that works with a keyboard.
  • Your ownership binder: a written record of every account you own and how to get in.
You own everything, from day one. Your web address, website, email, and Google listing are set up in your name, using your email, and billed to you. You set your own passwords. We never lock you out or take your site down, for any reason.

Two ways to pay for setup

Option 1: Pay in full. Pay the package price above. Care (below) is optional.

Option 2: Lower setup price with a 12-month Care plan. Pay a lower setup price when you keep Care for 12 months in a row.

If you cancel Care before the 12 months are up, an early-exit fee applies: your setup discount × the full months remaining ÷ 12. It is never more than your setup discount, and it goes down every month. After 12 months, Care continues month to month until you cancel, and we remind you 30 days before the 12 months end.

How payment works

  1. Sign your agreement.
  2. Pay a 50% deposit. We start when it clears.
  3. Review and approve your site.
  4. Pay the other 50%, and we hand everything over.

If you cancel before we tell you work has started, we refund your deposit in full. Once work has started, your deposit is non-refundable.

We invoice through QuickBooks. You can pay by bank transfer or card.

Care: $75/month

Someone keeping an eye on things, so you don't have to.

  • Monitoring, so we notice if your site goes down.
  • Secure connection and settings kept in good order.
  • Up to 30 minutes of updates each month (text, hours, photos). Unused time doesn't roll over; extra time is $100/hour.
  • A quarterly check-in on your Google listing, your reviews, and whether your business details match across the web.
  • Reminders before your web address or other accounts need renewing.

We respond to a reported outage within 1 business day and to other requests within 3 business days.

Cancel any time by email. Care ends at the end of the month you've paid for, with no refund for a partial month. On the 12-month plan, the early-exit fee above applies.

Costs you pay directly

These companies bill your own accounts directly. We don't mark them up or re-bill them, and their prices are set by them.

  • Business email (Google Workspace): about $7 to $8.40 per person per month, depending on the billing plan you choose with Google.
  • Your web address (.com): about $11 per year through Cloudflare.

Not included

Logo design, ongoing search engine optimization, advertising management, online stores or payment features, social media posting, booking or scheduling tools, and cleanup of hacked sites. Extra pages, extra rounds of changes, and extra writing are available at $100/hour, only with your approval first.
